scope: Local Linux private catalog, prepared immutable store sets, cooperating publishers. This covers selecting a generation; source quiescence, initial catalog persistence, and off-host custody are host responsibilities.
method: Run test_learning_store_set_recovery and test_learning_titan_integration on workspace overlayfs. Execute real fsync calls on the success path, observe file and directory order, then inject EIO at one call at a time.
limits: Injected faults precede the selected syscall. The test does not emulate storage hardware losing acknowledged writes, kernel crashes, or permanent media failure. Temporary generations are retained.
next: On an isolated disposable filesystem with an approved crash-capable runner, perform abrupt guest power removal at the durable selector boundaries, remount, verify pinned generations and replay. Preserve the previous generation until off-host readback is verified.
